_: THE DESK — the one page Mike opens. Pillars with their state, the instruments he uses, what he owes (read live from docs/HANDOFF_next_session.md), the reel line's week, the costs line. Ops keeps the pillar lines current; everything else is read from the tree at render. `npm run desk` writes docs/desk/DESK.html; the served copy is published from that file.

pillars.name: You
pillars.line: The centre. Every pillar points here. Your words are the canon; your look is fixed; the daily determination is your soapbox.

pillars.name: The Robots
pillars.line: The story starts Monday 09-07 at five. The daily determination is the spine from the day the machine is shown, week two.
pillars.next: Record 001 lands Sunday; the choreography is re-cut reel-first Sunday.

pillars.name: The Music
pillars.line: A live number every weekday from week two, one song at a time; Coconuts first; the record only for a song that catches; the album when a couple have.
pillars.next: Friday 09-18's number to shoot; the room, the room's light.

pillars.name: Reach
pillars.line: Two reels a weekday to four surfaces through Buffer; the pop ends every reel; the calendar is the schedule.
pillars.state: built; waits on your six clicks

pillars.name: The Foundation
pillars.line: A posture, no pipes: National Coalition for the Homeless. The room's copy is yours to write.
pillars.next: After Sunday: repoint the roster and link; your copy.

pillars.name: The System
pillars.line: Ops in Code; the ledgers cut; the calendar, the reel line, the cost ledger and this desk. Gates green.
pillars.next: Sunday: the Never-Advertised reading, the TikTok spec rewritten whole.
